title: Project Engineer | FIFO & Metro
abstract: Join TCD and play a key role in delivering civil construction and water infrastructure projects across WA.
bullets: FIFO and Perth Metro opportunities available
Work across varied engineering scopes from planning through to delivery
Long-term project opportunities with an established WA-owned business
screening_questions: How many years' experience do you have as a project engineer?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Have you completed a qualification in civil engineering?
Do you have experience working on civil infrastructure projects?
How many years' experience do you have in the construction industry?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
What's your expected annual base salary?
content_text:
TCD is a proud Western Australian owned company operating within the Resources and Construction sectors.
Driven by our core values and a positive, forward-thinking culture, our team embraces innovation and continuous improvement to remain at the forefront of our industry. Investing in our people and developing the knowledge and capabilities of our workforce is central to our success.
We are seeking experienced Project Engineers to join our team, working across a range of projects throughout the Pilbara region and Perth Metro area.
These positions offer the opportunity to be involved in diverse civil construction, dewatering and water infrastructure projects, including drainage and roadworks, turkey nests, dewatering systems, HDPE pipelines, bore and tank installations, fabrication and mine site water management.
The successful candidates will bring strong technical knowledge, practical site experience and the ability to work collaboratively with project teams to support the successful delivery of works.
WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:
- Choice of FIFO or Perth Metro opportunities
- Long-term secure pipeline of work
- Exposure to a diverse range of clients, projects and locations
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression
ABOUT THE ROLE
- Provide engineering and technical support to ensure the successful delivery of project scopes.
- Work closely with Project Managers and site teams to coordinate work schedules, priorities and project activities.
- Review and interpret project specifications, drawings, schedules and scope requirements.
- Liaise with clients, subcontractors and site management teams to coordinate project activities and resolve technical issues.
- Manage project documentation, quality records, compliance and reporting requirements in accordance with company systems and procedures.
- Coordinate resources, including personnel, plant, materials and subcontractors, to support project delivery.
- Support site teams in planning and executing works safely and efficiently.
- Monitor and maintain QA/QC compliance throughout project delivery.
- Assist with project cost tracking, forecasting and progress reporting.
ABOUT YOU:
- Tertiary qualifications in Civil or Mechanical Engineering.
- Minimum two (2) years' experience in civil construction, dewatering and/or piping projects, including earthworks, drainage, pipelines, pumping systems and associated installations, with knowledge of pumps, HDPE and steel pipework, hydrotesting, commissioning and detailed civil earthworks.
- Proficiency in project planning, scheduling and reporting, including the use of MS Project or Primavera.
- Sound understanding of project cost management, forecasting and financial reporting.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence engaging with clients, stakeholders and site teams.
- Well-developed organisational and problem-solving skills, with the capacity to manage competing priorities.
- A proactive, flexible approach and willingness to work both autonomously and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
- Commitment to maintaining high standards of safety, quality and continuous improvement.
If you are interested in joining the TCD Team, Apply Now!
TCD is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.
TCD does not accept unsolicited resume referrals from recruitment agencies and will not pay placement fees relating to unsolicited referrals.
Please Note: Only applicants with Australian working rights will be considered for this opportunity.
